prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with long dark hair wearing a white long-sleeve crop top and white high-waisted shorts"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01","P02"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"P01 and P02 both have long dark hair and are wearing a white long-sleeve crop top and white high-waisted shorts. P03 and P04 have light-colored hair (blonde/ash blonde) and do not match the hair color requirement. All clothing details are clearly visible and consistent across crops for P01 and P02."}

parsed.reason: P01 and P02 both have long dark hair and are wearing a white long-sleeve crop top and white high-waisted shorts. P03 and P04 have light-colored hair (blonde/ash blonde) and do not match the hair color requirement. All clothing details are clearly visible and consistent across crops for P01 and P02.
